## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the coding standards.
- [ ] Tests cover the relevant behavior and failure cases.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Observability is sufficient to detect and diagnose failure.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and migration safety were considered.
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated for a significant decision.
